title: Missing HTTP client timeout
summary: Using http.Client or default clients without explicit timeouts.
rationale: Missing timeouts can pin goroutines and connections during network slowness.

detection.notes: Detect http.DefaultClient, http.Get, or clients with zero Timeout in service paths.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Set client, request, dial, TLS, and response-header timeouts appropriate to the dependency.
remediation.tradeoffs: Timeouts need service-level objectives and retry policy alignment.
